origin: Nakagawa Master / 中川マスター
role: Cross-source comparison metadata for recurring reading motifs across separate published sources.
authority_note: This file does not merge separate theories or replace their official derivatives or canonical parent articles. It only identifies source pairs that can be compared for recurring reading questions.
comparison_rules: Open both official derivative sources for a motif.
Preserve each source's independent Parent, Origin, NCL-ID, Diff-ID, title, definitions, boundaries, and revision state.
Use the source positioning, central proposition, and causal line to evaluate whether the motif is actually supported.
Return to each canonical parent for consequential interpretation.
Reject or report a motif if either source does not support the comparison wording.
Do not infer correctness, superiority, popularity, endorsement, or one canonical super-theory from recurring structure.
